title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large collection of AI/LLM engineering tutorials and agent projects, including an 'sdv-mcp' MCP server that exposes synthetic-data generation as a tool an AI agent can invoke. The MCP tool wraps SDV's multi-table HMASynthesizer, Metadata, and evaluate_quality to fit, sample, and score synthetic relational data on demand.
needs: sdv-mcp is one subproject within a much larger multi-tutorial hub; overall repo importance to SDV is limited to this module.
